title: Lights Out: an independent analysis of Bangladesh's 2026 load shedding
description:
Analysis code, review checks and a small data pack for an independent study of Bangladesh's 2026 load shedding, built from public hourly PGCB grid data (2015 to 15 November 2026), BPDB daily zone reports and Open-Meteo weather. Every published finding is recomputed a second way by 05_review/verify.py.

Code is under the MIT licence. The data stays with its sources (PGCB and BPDB via Mendeley Data, CC BY 4.0; Open-Meteo, CC BY 4.0); credit them when you reuse it.
